configuration_provenance.owner: AI-assisted initial forecast policy under user authorization; editable estimates, not financial approval
configuration_provenance.operating: Uses Apple fiscal periods: nine months2025-09-28 to2026-06-27, not calendar nine months. Prior fiscal Q4 is retained annual416.161bn minus reported prior YTD313.695bn. Extend that102.466bn quarter by current/prior June-quarter growth. Fade growth to5% and reported latest-quarter operating margin to31.5%. Tax18% to20% is a forecasting convention, not a reported sustainable tax rate.
configuration_provenance.investment: Annualize reported nine-month cash PP&E6.799bn by4/3; do not copy an infrastructure spending plan from another issuer. Later cash PP&E grows10%,8%,6%,5%. A separately configured1% new-financed-assets estimate and10% commissioning allowance are forecast assumptions, not inferred from the undisclosed operating/finance lease split.
configuration_provenance.wc: 0.05 of incremental revenue converted to full-revenue cash needs; analyst convention, not calibration from mixed historical CFO. Taxes, capital creditors, acquisitions, financing and collateral excluded.
configuration_provenance.wacc: Shared dated Treasury/ERP observations; company-specific configured beta, spread, target financing weights and tax shield. No observed issuer beta regression or current market weights are claimed.
configuration_provenance.terminal: Independent nominal-USD growth, operating margin, tax, D&A, investment and incremental cash assumptions. No year-five copy or target-EV solving.
configuration_provenance.scenario: Diagnostic offsets only, not researched probabilities, fair-value bounds or guaranteed ordering. Unchanged ratios inherit Base.

diagnostics: FY2026 remains estimated using the retained July filing; this policy does not assert that an unavailable September-year-end result has been reported.
Prior fiscal Q4 revenue is annual less nine-month revenue; no calendar-Q4 substitution. Quarter momentum and4/3 annualizations do not normalize seasonality or acquisitions.
Latest-quarter reported operating margin includes tariff-refund effects; the31.5% endpoint is an independent assumption, not a claim of normalized reported earnings.
Expense D&A starts from4/3 of cash-flow D&A; expense alignment, acquisitions and future intangible amortization remain uncertain.
The1% financed-additions overlay is an explicit forecast estimate; missing historical lease splits and historical interest gaps are not solved.
Terminal D&A2.5% and investment3.5% are independent mature assumptions; no implied historical ROIC, equity bridge or years6–10 defaults.
